builtin.name: Waze on cluster + cluster-render (Robert Nisipeanu)
builtin.description: Robert Nisipeanu's Waze turn-by-turn on the instrument cluster, and cluster-render, the renderer the cluster / HUD apps draw through. Not the same as the eroobeeroo / pinguinooo 'idrive7' repos below.

builtin.name: MGU custom apps (cauliflowermossgrape)
builtin.description: The original MGU custom apps (shift lights, virtual dyno, timers, G-meter, fault scanner) and the shared renderer / input gate the other apps need.

builtin.name: IterioDev car-apps
builtin.description: IterioDev's apps and tools (Car Data, Drag Timer, Drive Recorder, eDrive, Fault Codes, Service, Tailscale). Mostly iDrive 8.

sources.name: RideTube for iDrive 8 (beta)
sources.description: RideTube, the unofficial YouTube client, ported to iDrive 8 (beta, not yet confirmed on an iDrive 8 car); video plays only while parked.

sources.name: RideTube for iDrive 7
sources.description: The original RideTube unofficial YouTube client for iDrive 7; video plays only while parked. (This is the one the tool's 'Add RideTube' button installs.)

also.why: it provides jap-node22, the Node.js 22 RideTube's service runs on

sources.name: JustAnotherPU MGU Apps & tools
sources.description: Head-unit tools: iDrive Monitor (system monitor), wireproxy (for Tailscale) and Node.js 22 (jap-node22). RideTube needs the Node.js 22 from here.

sources.name: Waze HUD
sources.description: Waze turn-by-turn arrows from CarPlay on the HUD and instrument cluster. It draws through cluster-render, which is already in the Store (robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps, above).

sources.name: hexlay Custom Apps (Spotify, M-Copilot)
sources.description: A Spotify Connect controller with library browser, and M-Copilot, an AI assistant that reads vehicle data. Uses the renderer from the built-in cauliflowermossgrape/idrive7-apps source.

sources.name: pinguinooo Cluster Mods (Shift Lights, Vitals, M Track)
sources.description: Cluster / gauge mods: Shift Lights, Engine Vitals and an M Track cluster layout.

sources.name: eroobeeroo Cluster Mods (Info, Layouts, Centre)
sources.description: iDrive 7 customization and cluster mods: Cluster Info, Cluster Layouts and Cluster Centre, putting live data and custom layouts on the cluster and HUD.

also.why: the shared parts these cluster apps build on

sources.name: bimmer-lab Cluster Mod (Themes + HUD Widgets)
sources.description: Cluster Themes (redraws the instrument cluster) and HUD Widgets (custom HUD readouts). Install cluster-render (built-in robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps) first.

sources.name: alexp50 BMW Apps (15 full-screen apps)
sources.description: Fifteen full-screen apps, including Ambient Studio, DPF Monitor, Drive HUD, Telemetry Studio, Waze HUD and xDrive Studio.

not_sources.name: BMW Ambient RGB Controller
not_sources.description: Gives a G20's factory ambient lighting any colour: hue ring, brightness, upper and lower zones, animated modes.
not_sources.why: built with the MGU App Kit and not published as a Store source; build and install it yourself from the repo.

not_sources.name: MGU App Store (JustAnotherPU fork)
not_sources.description: A fork of the MGU App Store itself.
not_sources.why: it is the Store, not a list of apps; the Bimmhacks MGU Tool installs the Store for you (App Store tab).

not_sources.name: NBT Evo ID6 apps (pre-release)
not_sources.description: BoostDeck, ShiftDeck and MHD Maps menus built for NBT Evo head units over ENET.
not_sources.why: made for the older NBT Evo (iDrive 6) unit, not the MGU; it does not run on iDrive 7 or 8.
